data.title: Base Sets Quantum Security as 2027 Priority, Everest Upgrade to Add New Transaction Type
data.description: Base has made quantum security a priority for 2027, and its upcoming Everest upgrade will introduce a new transaction type called Base Transactions. According to Odaily, Base founder Jesse Pollak said the format, outlined in the EIP-8430 technical specification, still relies on existing cryptography but separates transaction signing from verification. This design would allow the network to adopt new security methods in the future without requiring users to change wallet addresses. Pollak said the upgrade will not immediately make wallets quantum-resistant; it is an early step toward adding further protections.

data.title: Elon Musk: Friends Who Support You in Adversity Are True Friends, After Jensen Huang's Return as Nvidia CEO
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk voiced support for his friend Jensen Huang on Monday after Nvidia's board unanimously decided to reinstate Huang as CEO. Musk also criticized those who had not publicly and firmly supported Huang during his difficulties.

Responding on X to a post about his support for Huang, Musk wrote, “Everyone is your friend in good times, but those who support you in adversity are true friends.” He added, “Fair-weather friends are worthless.” Earlier on Monday, after learning of the board's decision, Musk wrote, “It worked,” then added, “The mistake has been corrected.” Throughout the turmoil that led to Huang's resignation, Musk had been one of his staunchest supporters. He had publicly backed efforts to bring Huang back and referred to a petition circulating at the time.

data.title: South Korea Offers Informants Up to 500 Million Won for Exam Cheating Reports
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, South Korea's Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission (ACRC) said Monday that it would offer rewards of up to 500 million won for reports of cheating on the annual college entrance exam. A report that leads to a confirmed case qualifies for a 100 million won reward, and the total reward can reach 500 million won, equivalent to approximately $370,888.

The commission said people who voluntarily confess to cheating and report accomplices may receive the full reward and have their own penalties reduced. The measure aims to protect the fairness and credibility of the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) by encouraging the public to report cheating, including cheating using artificial intelligence.

As part of a two-month campaign, the commission will accept reports through January 19. Last week, South Korean authorities said confirmed cheaters could be barred from taking the exam for up to 10 years and that informants could receive rewards of up to 100 million won.

data.title: Anthropic Posts Claude’s VP ≠ VNP Proof, With No Human Verification
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, Anthropic added a `vp-vnp` directory to its GitHub repository `formal-math`, publishing a paper titled “VP ≠ VNP over every field” and a Lean 4 formalization attributed to Claude (Anthropic). The work claims to prove that VP is a strict subset of VNP over any field, addressing Valiant’s conjecture in algebraic complexity theory.

The paper says an internal research Claude model discovered the result. It claims superpolynomial circuit-size lower bounds for computing the Hamiltonian cycle polynomial over any field and the permanent when the field’s characteristic is not 2. Anthropic said the result does not resolve P vs. NP.

Anthropic said AI models wrote both the paper and formal proof, and no human mathematician has checked the proof. Lean can verify proof steps, but no machine can confirm that the formalized statement fully matches the claimed conclusion. Leslie Valiant proposed the conjecture in 1979; it is considered an algebraic analogue of P vs. NP.

data.title: CBOT Soybeans Rise 0.7%, Following Soybean Meal Gains
data.description: According to Jin10, CBOT soybean futures closed modestly higher on Monday, with the benchmark contract up 0.7%, following gains in the neighboring soybean meal market. Analysts said U.S. markets would be closed on Thursday for Thanksgiving, and the holiday mood and lack of catalysts for major price swings were weighing on activity. Trading volume has gradually declined as the week progresses. Improved U.S. demand for soybean meal and firming prices supported soybean futures. Analysts said the market was still recovering from tight soybean meal supplies after slow progress early in the harvest forced crushers to cut output or suspend operations. Replenishment of soybean meal supplies had been slow over the past month or two.

data.title: STOCKS | SK Hynix ADRs Surge 20% as Jensen Huang Returns as Nvidia CEO
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, SK Hynix’s U.S.-listed American depositary receipts (ADRs) rose 20% on Monday, gaining $20.71 to close at $124.28. The previous session’s close was $103.57. The rally followed Nvidia’s announcement that its board had unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO and a board member, effective immediately, after discussions with him. Nvidia said the board had also heard from senior U.S. government officials and was confident Huang’s return would not pose a national security risk.

SK Hynix is a major supplier of the high-bandwidth memory chips used in Nvidia’s AI processors. The news appeared to bolster confidence in AI-related stocks and buying interest in semiconductor shares, after recent volatility in technology and semiconductor stocks. The S&P 500 rose 4.7% on Monday, while the Nasdaq Composite gained 6.5% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 3%. Nvidia shares climbed 31.48% to close at $165.05. U.S. President Donald Trump welcomed Huang’s return on Truth Social, calling the board’s decision “right and proper” and congratulating Huang, Nvidia’s board, the American people and the world.

data.title: Threshold Approves Proposal to Replace T Staking Fee Rebates With Peg Keeper Whitelist
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing The Defiant, the Threshold Network community approved a proposal to replace T staking fee rebates with a Peg Keeper whitelist as the basis for discounted tBTC fees. Whitelisted addresses, approved and managed by the Threshold Council, will be able to mint and redeem tBTC without fees and support its price peg through arbitrage.

Proposal author maclane said the T staking fee-waiver program, launched earlier this year, helped anchor tBTC to BTC but saw little participation beyond arbitrage and peg maintenance. Since August, one address received about 92% of fee rebates: 2.2 BTC out of roughly 2.4 BTC. Under the new model, the DAO can fund Peg Keepers, with arbitrage profits going to the DAO treasury; maclane estimates the change could generate about 4 BTC in additional annual revenue.

Rebates for existing stakers will continue at least until the 30-day unstaking window ends, or December 24, 2026, at 00:00 UTC. Holders will not be locked in or charged an exit penalty. The change is part of Threshold’s plan to reduce protocol risk and retire underused features.

data.title: CFTC Guidance Requires at Least 20% Haircuts for Bitcoin and Ether in Operating Reserves
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission staff issued guidance on using crypto assets in operating reserves, requiring Bitcoin and ether to be valued with at least a 20% haircut and eligible payment stablecoins with a 2% haircut. The guidance also says these assets cannot count toward the minimum liquidity requirement for operating resources.
